note: Fictional. The LLD deliberately breaks some HLD commitments and is silent on others. 'claim_contains' identifies the HLD sentence; 'lld_contains' is the line that proves the verdict.

contradicted.why: HLD mandates TLS 1.3 everywhere; the LLD sets TLS 1.2 and keeps a broker on it.

contradicted.lld_contains: excluded from the conditional access policy
contradicted.why: Break-glass accounts are exempt from the MFA policy the HLD made unconditional.
The audit store is public; the HLD said no data-tier component is.

contradicted.lld_contains: nightly copy of the production claims database
contradicted.why: Non-production is loaded from production data the HLD classified Restricted.

contradicted.claim_contains: accepts connections only from the application and integration tiers
contradicted.lld_contains: non-production subscription is peered to the production hub
contradicted.why: Non-production can reach the production data tier.

contradicted.claim_contains: never held in configuration files, images or pipeline variables
contradicted.why: Registry credentials live in a pipeline variable group.
Retention is a fifth of what the HLD committed to.

missing.why: The LLD names the key vault but never says keys are rotated.
Backups are geo-redundant but not immutable, and no restore test is described.
Logs go to a workspace; nothing forwards them to the SIEM.
The LLD describes no alerting at all.
Images are built and pushed with no scan step.
The LLD never states RPO or RTO.
